items.title: CMU Robotics Institute Project to Connect Autonomous Laboratories Selected for DOE Genesis Mission Funding
items.summary_en: Carnegie Mellon University researchers, including Robotics Institute faculty, are developing AI-based tools to let autonomous laboratories at different sites share robotic capabilities and AI-generated software modules as one connected research ecosystem. The project, funded through the U.S. Department of Energy's Genesis Mission, aims to sharply cut the time needed to stand up new autonomous science experiments, with CMU partnering with national laboratories and other universities.
items.notes: A version of this story first appeared on CMU's main news site dated July 2026 (cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2026/july/connecting-autonomous-laboratories-to-speed-scientific-advancement); the Robotics Institute's own news listing shows it under Sept 3, 2026, likely reflecting a cross-post/re-listing date. Direct fetch of ri.cmu.edu was blocked by network egress restrictions during this collection run, so this entry relies on search-engine snippets rather than a rendered page; please spot-check before publication.

items.title: CMU Robotics Institute Pathways Fellowship Launches Fourth Cohort
items.summary_en: The Robotics Institute's Pathways Fellowship, run in partnership with InnovatePGH to support non-traditional entrepreneurial talent in robotics, began its fourth year of programming with a new cohort of seven engineers, designers, and entrepreneurs.
items.notes: This is an institutional workforce/entrepreneurship program announcement rather than a technical AI research result; included for completeness since it is a primary item on RI's own news feed within the collection window. Direct fetch of ri.cmu.edu was blocked by network egress restrictions during this run, so this entry relies on search-engine snippets rather than a rendered page; please spot-check before publication.
